entry.title: x3d.mandala 2.0: the Chamber Harp
entry.content:
x3d.mandala 2.0: the Chamber Harp

Make the 43 canonical chambers playable without moving a vertex:
- one TouchSensor plus a pure point-in-chamber locator (43/43 independent
  interior samples land in their own chamber); an invisible R=1 plate makes
  voids pickable so a touch between chambers explains its even coverage
- bell strikes (1, 2.756, 5.404 partials) through the 1.0 filter, delays,
  reverb and gain ceiling; 26 bilateral classes share pitches and rise
  pentatonically toward the bindu; keys 1-5 strike whole rings
- 43 chamber lights and 9 covering-triangle lights; an inward spiral lit by
  the transport that ends in bindu sparks; a Resonance wave outward
- 60-gem spark pool animated by Transforms only (no ParticleSystem: that
  component is not in the vendored X_ITE bundle)
- halo bloom overlay with a software-GL default-off and a 30 ms governor
- immersive view recentres; optional chamber-spiral melody voice

Canonical YantraCoordinates unchanged; checked in tests and after every
browser interaction. 25/25 node tests, 5/5 python tests, pinned x3d_mcp gate
pass (0 errors), upstream UI and audio witnesses pass, new harp gate 22/22.
Docs: docs/CHAMBER-HARP.md, docs/HARP-GAPS.md, loom learnings extended.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
